name: flying-edelweiss
description: 飞行雪绒 — 鸣潮角色爱弥斯的同人社交账号体验网站

scripts.deploy: echo 'Push to GitHub → Settings → Pages → main branch'
scripts.syntax-check: for f in js/*.js; do node -c "$f" && echo "OK: $f" || echo "FAIL: $f"; done
scripts.db:migrate-001: echo 'Run db/migration-001-init.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-002: echo 'Run db/migration-002-rls-hardening.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-003: echo 'Run db/migration-003-fixes.sql in Supabase SQL Editor'
scripts.db:migrate-004: echo 'Run db/migration-004-fix-search-path.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — REQUIRED after 003'
scripts.db:migrate-005: echo 'Run db/migration-005-unlike-rpc.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — enables unlike sync'
scripts.db:migrate-006: echo 'Run db/migration-006-comment-moderation.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — comment deletion tokens + roles + soft delete'
scripts.db:migrate-007: echo 'Run db/migration-007-rate-limit-v2.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — tiered rate limiting'
scripts.db:migrate-008: echo 'Run db/migration-008-tags-bookmarks.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — tags + bookmarks + collections'
scripts.db:migrate-009: echo 'Run db/migration-009-storage-bucket.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — Storage bucket for uploads'
scripts.db:migrate-010: echo 'Run db/migration-010-fix-quota-name-type.sql in Supabase SQL Editor — fix check_daily_quota (uuid,name) error'
